priorityList: Cast Haunt as your top priority to maintain its debuff on the primary target.
Use Seed of Corruption to apply or refresh Wither on the group if it is missing or refreshable.
Cast Dark Harvest on cooldown to generate Soul Shards and increase throughput.
Maintain Agony on all targets, prioritizing targets where the dot is about to expire.
Summon Darkglare when your primary dots (Wither and Agony) are active on the pack.
Use Malevolence as a major cooldown, ideally paired with Summon Darkglare.
Use offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury) while Darkglare is active.
Spend Soul Shards on Seed of Corruption as your primary spender in AoE (3+ targets).
Use Unstable Affliction if you have a Shard Instability proc or are capping Soul Shards in Cleave (2 targets).
If Nocturnal Yield is talented, use Seed of Corruption when Nightfall reaches max stacks or is about to expire.
In Cleave (2 targets), manually refresh Wither and Agony if they are about to expire and Seed of Corruption is not in flight.
Cast Malefic Grasp (or Drain Soul/Shadow Bolt filler) when your Darkglare has less than one GCD remaining.
Use Seed of Corruption as your Shard spender if Sow the Seeds and Patient Zero are both talented.
In Cleave situations where Sow the Seeds is not talented, prioritize Unstable Affliction over Seed of Corruption for Shard spending.
Use Malefic Grasp, Drain Soul, or Shadow Bolt as filler when all dots are applied and no Shards are available for spending.
